security_review.headline: The scheme guard is load-bearing, not decorative: the reviewer proved with the repo's own zod 4.5.4 that z.url() ACCEPTS javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file:, and that ConferenceSchema.safeParse at google-event.normalizer.ts:169 is the only ingest validation and has no scheme constraint. This feature closes a gap the codebase did not previously cover.
security_review.r1_assessment: Agrees R-1 fails safe, for a STRONGER reason than the senior review gave. Could not confirm the senior review's specific 'form opens instead of meeting' claim -- per spec, cancelling pointerdown does not suppress click, so the outcome is either (a) form only or (b) form AND meeting. Security-wise it does not matter: in both branches the only value reaching window.open passed isJoinableUrl microseconds earlier, so the security property is ORTHOGONAL to R-1, not protected by it. New consequence the senior review missed: a pointerdown on the button arms a drag of the underlying event, so a slip could reschedule the meeting -- bounded by INTERACTION_MOVE_THRESHOLD_PX=25 vs a 10x10 button. Correctness note, not security.
